aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_structure_r.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 3
aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_structure_r.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum (or a molten restart) and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_potential_f.name: Aluminum Potential File for Quenching - Level 3
aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_potential_f.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.name: Aluminum NPT Quenching - Level 3
aluminum_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum molten restart (or structure) and EAM potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching of the system and return the glass transition temperature (Tg) in Kelvin.
